caseNameFull: National Lawyers Guild v. Brownell, Attorney General
attorneys: Osmond K. Fraenkel, Robert W. Kenny, Earl B. Dickerson and Joseph Forer for petitioner. Solicitor General Sobeloff, Assistant Attorney General Burger, Samuel D. Slade and Benjamin Forman for respondent.

opinions.text:
United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion certiorari should be granted.
